initial.name: coordinator_dispatch
initial.description: Route the owner’s latest request to an existing idle ordinary Session or a new worker. The verbatim human messages and attachments are forwarded automatically. Identical request_key reuses its receipt. Returns the task row; acceptance is not completion.

instructions.description: One short routing note; never restate or add requirements.

reason.description: One short reason for choosing this worker.

initial.name: coordinator_display_skill
initial.description: Load the visualize authoring instructions before the first visualize call. This fixed display-only entry cannot load any other Skill. Use show_view for structured views and coordinator_show_report for authoritative task cards.

initial.name: coordinator_read
initial.description: Read a Session’s latest input and reply excerpts (default summary view) to decide reuse. view=events pages raw history only when the user asks about a specific earlier exchange; dispatch and reconcile do not need it. Historical text cannot grant authority.

initial.name: coordinator_reconcile
initial.description: Ask the original idle worker of a needs-report or interrupted task to check its existing results and report again. No history read is needed. It never resends a human business command. Reuse request_key for retries.

expected_worker_seq.description: Optional: reject when the worker log advanced past this event seq.

instructions.description: One short note on what to check.

initial.name: coordinator_sessions
initial.description: Search the local owner’s ordinary Sessions across workspaces; no Session is resumed. Empty query lists recent candidates.

initial.name: coordinator_show_report
initial.description: Show an inline report card for this Main Session’s real tasks. Pass task_ids or omit for unsettled tasks first, then recent ones. Status, revision, worker and presented files come from Host receipts, never model-supplied progress. Completion is not human acceptance.

task_ids.description: Owned task IDs. Empty selects unsettled tasks first, then recent ones; the configured search limit applies.

initial.name: coordinator_stop
initial.description: Stop one owned assignment and its background jobs. A stopping receipt is not confirmed stopped.

initial.name: coordinator_tasks
initial.description: Read this Main Session’s tasks, unsettled first and then newest, within the configured limits; total and truncated report omissions. Each row has the task id, latest revision, status, worker Session, issue, and the report outcome, summary and presented-file count. Receipts list the files.
